clips.title: The story
paras: Orm Stonehoof sends a Horde warrior into the Charred Vale to face a suffering chimaera matriarch. Her horn is needed for the Brutal Helm, and the hunt tests the warrior’s strength and mercy.

Orm Stonehoof will forge the Brutal Helm for Horde warriors, but tradition calls for proof before he begins. He asks for more than metal or coin: the warrior must show martial skill and face the scars left by devastating conflict.

In the southwestern Stonetalon Mountains, the Charred Vale lies in ash. Once lush and green, the valley was burned into a smoking wasteland. Beasts still wander its soot-covered craters, twisted by pain and fury. Mighty chimaeras nest among dead trees and searing steam vents.

For the tauren smith, the chimaera matriarch’s horn is both a needed piece for the helm and proof of strength. The hunt also ends the matriarch’s torment. By felling her, the warrior brings mercy to a wild spirit driven mad by the destruction of its home.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I will make you the helm, but you must show me you are worthy of it.

Nestled in the northwestern reaches of the Stonetalon Mountains there lies the Charred Vale. It was once a verdant place, but is now defiled and ashen, and what creatures remain there are mad with pain and despair.
That place is where I send you, friend.
You must go to the Charred Vale and find a chimaera matriarch. Slay her, free her of her misery. Bring me her galvanized horn as proof, and I shall make for you the helm.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the horn? Is the matriarch free of pain?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have completed your task, friend, and shown me your worth and resolve. The helm will be yours...
